One model, no account at all

FREE, LIMITED PER NETWORK EACH DAY

Generate without signing in, without an email and without a card — one lifetime demo per IP address, not a daily allowance. You can rotate and inspect the result in full; the download is the step that asks for an account, and your model is kept across the sign-up.

3 credits at signup

FREE, ONCE PER ACCOUNT

A new account receives 3 credits right away, and one textured generation costs 3 — that's 1 model outright — a real trial, but a fixed one, not an ongoing quota.

Then the plans, and we say so up front

FROM $9, ONE-OFF

That is 2 free generations in total — one before you register and 1 after — and then a credit pack from $9 or a plan from $19/mo. It does not renew each day, and there is no version of this page where the free path quietly continues.

Seven browser tools, unlimited, forever

FREE WITH NO CAP

The GLB viewer, OBJ viewer, OBJ to STL converter, STL to 3MF converter, 3MF to STL converter, STL simplifier and 3D text generator are not trials. They run entirely inside your browser on files you own, have no upload endpoint, no credit cost and no account requirement, and they will still be free when your generation credits have run out.

HONEST BY DESIGN

What we are not doing to the free output.
2 generations is a trial, and we call it one

2 free models is enough to find out whether single-image reconstruction suits your subject. It is not enough to finish a project on, and a page that implied otherwise would be setting up the wall it later runs you into.

Free output is not crippled — it is the whole pipeline

No watermark on the model, and no separate lower-quality free pipeline. A signed-in account can download the textured GLB — included with the account in some regions, or part of a small one-off per-model unlock in others. OBJ, STL, 3MF and FBX are a paid per-model unlock everywhere. Since 16 September 2026 the free tier runs the same Turbo model at the same settings a paying account gets on an ordinary generation — there is no higher-resolution texture or lighter mesh simplification to buy any more. What paying does get you: the separate High Detail model, the commercial licence with no attribution line, API access, more credits, and a higher concurrency cap. The anonymous demo previews the model, and registering is what releases the GLB download.

Free does not mean print-ready

Cost is not the limit that will bite you first. A single image cannot see hidden surfaces, so any export is an editable

Can I use generated models commercially?

Paid plans include a commercial, client-ready license. Free preview renders are for personal evaluation — upgrade to Pro to ship models in client and product work.

Is it really free without signing up?

Yes. You get 2 free preview renders per day without an account — watermarked, up to 20K faces. That is enough to test any image before you commit.

What are the limits of the free preview?

Free previews are watermarked and capped at 20K polygons. A free account unlocks watermark-free downloads at the same quality; Pro raises the ceiling to 1M faces with full texture maps.

Which AI engines can I choose?

The workbench lets you pick between reconstruction engines tuned for different subjects — hard-surface props, characters or organic shapes. You can switch engines between previews at no cost.

Is the output printable / watertight?

Yes. The mesh reconstruction fills occluded areas and produces a watertight, manifold mesh that slices cleanly in Cura, PrusaSlicer or Bambu Studio. Export STL for printing.

OBJ, GLB or STL — which should I pick?

GLB for web, AR and engines (textures bundled, smallest file). OBJ for Blender, Maya and sculpting pipelines. STL for 3D printing slicers — mesh only, no textures.

How is this different from height-map converters?

Height-map tools turn pixel brightness into a flat relief. This generator reconstructs a full, editable 3D model — including the hidden sides — so results are usable in engines and printers, not just as plaques.
